dedupe_keys.name: plattform fur abwarme german register of industrial waste heat sources bfee

description: Germany's public register of waste heat available from companies. The BfEE page says companies with total final energy use above 2.5 GWh a year must report their waste heat under section 17 of the Energy Efficiency Act (EnEfG), and that all public reports up to 5 July 2026 cover more than 3,000 firms and over 23,000 waste heat sources with 207 TWh of waste heat a year. The data can be viewed online or downloaded free as an Excel file without registration, are updated regularly, and since September 2025 carry company and report IDs; a map shows their spread across Germany. The FAQ says the list may only be used unaltered. Coverage is Germany. Licence: not stated for the data; BAFA site texts are CC-BY-ND-3.0 (DE port). For simulation it locates industrial heat sources, to model district heating links and the loss of heat supply when plants stop. A related catalogue record is EU28 industrial process waste heat by process.
